boto3 multipart round-trip exposed an empty assembled file, traced to an XML-namespace parsing bug — evidence of edge-case data-plane verification reproducing grader (boto3) conditions.

reasoning: The agent goes clearly beyond the level-5 anchor: it uses real boto3 to exercise the main data plane and repeatedly round-trips through edge cases (multipart ETag/assembly, versioning, presigned, conditional headers), catching several non-obvious bugs via reproduced grader conditions. But it never builds a concurrency (30-client) test and never does any console DOM/data-testid verification despite the console being browser-graded, and it omits notification/lifecycle/audit-atomicity checks — two of the three components the level-8 anchor requires. That places it between the 5 and 8 anchors, at a 6.
